meta.description: Youth mentorship + environmental-impact platform. Two engines: Engine A (1:2 mentorship matching) and Engine B (corporate-ESG / tree-planting impact). This file documents the main runtime flows for humans and LLMs. File paths are authoritative; line numbers are indicative and may drift.

stack.reporting: Looker Studio (free) over Drizzle pgViews; no in-app reporting UI

roles.approval: MEAL Director (corporate scope) OR SuperAdmin JWT invite

moderatorScopes.note: Canonical scope strings. Legacy names (welfare|meal|commerce) are deprecated. SuperAdmin implicitly holds all scopes.

capabilities.helper: hasCapability(role, scopes, cap) — SuperAdmin always true; non-moderators false unless SuperAdmin

flows.name: Mentee registration
flows.trigger: Visitor chooses to join as a mentee

steps.action: Account form (name, level, email, password)
Community pledge acknowledgement (1 activity/quarter)
NDA signature -> signUp.email + setUserRole('Mentee') + signNDA

dbEffects: UPDATE users SET role='Mentee', ndaSigned=true, status='active'
flows.endState: Auto-approved (status=active). Redirect -> /check-email then /onboarding (intake).
rules: Mentees auto-approve on signup (CLAUDE.md §3)

flows.name: Mentor registration

steps.action: Profile form (title, LinkedIn optional)
Commitment (>=1 Power Hour/month, meeting preference)
NDA signature -> signUp + setUserRole('Mentor') + saveUserMetadata + signNDA

flows.endState: status=pending -> /pending-approval. Awaits Welfare & Compliance Officer approval.
rules: Mentor needs mentor_applications-scope approval (CLAUDE.md §3)

flows.name: Corporate Partner / NGO registration

steps.action: Organisation form; orgType=NGO skips step 2
Contribution protocol (corporate only)
NDA -> setUserRole('CorporatePartner'|'NGO') + saveUserMetadata + signNDA

flows.endState: status=pending -> /pending-approval. Awaits MEAL Director (corporate scope) OR fast-tracked via SuperAdmin JWT invite.
rules: Partner approval = corporate scope or SuperAdmin invite (CLAUDE.md §3)

flows.name: Login & session

steps.action: signIn.email({email,password})
If twoFactorRedirect -> /two-factor
Session cookie cache carries role, moderationScope, ndaSigned, intakeCompleted

flows.endState: Redirect to callbackUrl (default /dashboard, then role-routed).
rules: Better Auth: 7-day session, 24h refresh; requireEmailVerification=false (NDA works immediately)

flows.name: NDA signing (shared state machine)
flows.trigger: Final step of every registration flow

steps.action: Validate session
INSERT nda_signatures (hash, ip, ua, signatureName, roleAtSigning)
UPDATE users: status = Mentee?'active':'pending'; redirect by role

flows.endState: Role determines active vs pending. This is the approval state-machine trigger.
rules: Only Mentee -> active; all other roles -> pending

flows.name: Moderator approves / rejects user

steps.action: requireModerator(); approveUser(userId) or rejectUser(userId, reason)
UPDATE users SET isApproved/status; INSERT moderation_log; notify user

flows.endState: User -> active (approved) or stays pending with rejectionReason.
rules: Queue sections gated by scope: mentor_applications -> getPendingUsers; corporate/content -> review queues

flows.name: Moderator invite acceptance

steps.action: validateAdminInvite(token) against invite_links (unused, unexpired)
Account setup + Code of Conduct signature
signUp + setUserRole('Moderator') + setModeratorScope + signNDA + finishAdminInvite

flows.endState: Moderator active with scoped capabilities -> /dashboard/moderator.
rules: Scope set from invite_links.moderationScope

flows.name: SuperAdmin setup (invite + 2FA + NDA)
flows.trigger: Bootstrap a SuperAdmin via invite token

steps.action: bootstrapAdminSetPassword + finishAdminInvite + enable TOTP 2FA
Verify 6-digit TOTP (twoFactor.verifyTotp)
Sign Admin NDA -> status active

flows.endState: SuperAdmin active with 2FA -> /dashboard/admin.
rules: 2FA mandatory for SuperAdmin

flows.name: Corporate invite JWT (fast-track)
flows.trigger: SuperAdmin issues a corporate fast-track invite

steps.action: requireCapability('GENERATE_CORPORATE_INVITE_JWT') (SuperAdmin only)
Sign HS256 JWT (sub=email, role=CorporatePartner, 7d exp) + INSERT invite_links

flows.endState: Returns { token, expiresAt }. Bypasses MEAL Director approval gate.
rules: SuperAdmin-only (empty scope array)

flows.name: Email verification & password reset
flows.trigger: User verifies email or resets password

steps.action: verifyEmail({token}) consumes verifications row (optional gate)
requestPasswordReset({email}) -> emailed link
resetPassword({newPassword, token}) -> updates hash

flows.endState: Email verified or password updated -> /login.
rules: Email verification is optional (requireEmailVerification=false)

flows.name: AI mentor matching (read)
flows.trigger: Mentee or moderator requests ranked mentor matches

steps.action: Read user embedding (768-dim pgvector) + stale flag
Subqueries: active pair counts, profile asset counts
Weighted score across 6 dims; filter approved active mentors with <2 pairs; ORDER BY score LIMIT 5

dbEffects: READ users (embedding), mentorship_pairs, user_goal_tags, profile assets
flows.endState: Top 5 ranked mentors returned (read-only).
rules: Founder-locked weights: 40% semantic, 20% location, 15% availability (0.0 until column ships), 10% goal alignment, 10% partner, 5% completeness (CLAUDE.md §4)
Goal alignment uses normalized user_goal_tags table, not text[]
Pre-filter: coalesce(active_pair_count,0) < 2

flows.name: Mentor assignment (write, 1:2 capacity guard)
flows.trigger: A mentee is paired with a mentor

steps.action: Open transaction; count mentor's active pairs (excluding this mentee)
If activeOtherPairs >= 2 -> throw MENTOR_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED
Upsert mentorship_pairs status='active'; init learning pathway; log activity

flows.endState: Active pair created, mentor capacity preserved (max 2).
rules: Mentor max 2 active mentees enforced at read (pre-filter) AND write time (CLAUDE.md §5)

flows.name: KoBoToolbox field-data ingestion
flows.trigger: KoBo server POSTs a field submission (tree planting/survival/give-back)

steps.action: Authenticate x-kobo-token header (== KOBO_WEBHOOK_SECRET), else 401
Validate discriminated union (tree_survival | tree_planting | give_back), else 422
Idempotent insert ON CONFLICT (kobo_submission_id) DO NOTHING into the matching table
Return 200 immediately; fire-and-forget checkAndUnlockMilestones('tree_survival')

flows.endState: Submission stored once; milestone check runs async.
rules: Single Responsibility (CLAUDE.md §2): authenticate, idempotent insert, 200, async milestone trigger. NEVER generate reports/emails inside the handler.

flows.name: Tree planting & survival derivation
flows.trigger: Reporting / unlock evaluation reads tree metrics

steps.action: trees-planted derived via v_project_location_plantings (SUM over tree_planting_events) — never a denormalized integer
survival counted via DISTINCT ON (project_location_id) ORDER BY survey_date DESC, then SUM(trees_alive)

flows.endState: Each location counted once at its latest audit; aggregate trees alive computed.
rules: Never naive SUM(trees_alive) across all rows (CLAUDE.md §2). GPS stored as numeric(10,7).

flows.name: Corporate ESG milestone unlock
flows.trigger: KoBo webhook OR nightly cron OR admin override

steps.action: Compute totalAlive via DISTINCT ON latest audit per location
For each LOCKED milestone: if currentValue >= thresholdValue -> UNLOCKED + verifiedAt; else record progress
Flip linked corporate_resources to UNLOCKED

flows.endState: Milestones unlock corporate resources when survival thresholds are met.
rules: SuperAdmin-only fund unlock capability: UNLOCK_CORPORATE_ESG_FUNDS

flows.name: Cron: Three Strikes (give-back enforcement)

steps.action: Bearer CRON_SECRET guard, else 401
Per active mentee: check previous-quarter give_back completion; increment strikeCount on miss
strike>=3 -> status under_review + notify moderators; 1-2 -> warn mentee

flows.endState: Non-participating mentees escalated for review.
rules: All cron routes: under /api/cron, Bearer CRON_SECRET, registered in vercel.json (CLAUDE.md §7)

flows.name: Cron: Power Hour check (mentor commitment)

steps.action: Bearer CRON_SECRET guard
Per active mentor: check previous month >=60 logged minutes; mark failed + notify on miss

flows.endState: Mentors who missed their Power Hour flagged.
rules: 1 Power Hour = 60 min/month

flows.name: Cron: Impact report snapshot

steps.action: Bearer CRON_SECRET guard
Aggregate donations sum + mentorship hours/sessions; INSERT impact_reports snapshot

flows.endState: Monthly snapshot row for Looker BI (trees/clinics currently placeholder).

flows.name: Cron: Resilience re-assessment

steps.action: Bearer CRON_SECRET guard
Find baselines with reassessmentDueDate<=now and no follow-up; notify user to re-assess

flows.endState: Users due for re-assessment are nudged to /onboarding/resilience?reassess=1.

flows.name: Cron: Corporate unlock safety net + cleanup

steps.action: Bearer CRON_SECRET guard
Re-run checkAndUnlockMilestones() (all types); DELETE rate_limit_buckets older than 24h

flows.endState: Redundant unlock pass in case webhook fire-and-forget failed.
rules: Reference pattern for cron auth guard

flows.name: Cron: Embedding refresh & orphan-asset cleanup

steps.action: refresh-embeddings: re-synthesize stale profile embeddings (batch ~25)
cleanup-orphan-assets: garbage-collect unreferenced Sanity images (weekly)

flows.endState: Embeddings stay fresh for matching; CMS asset storage stays lean.

flows.name: Article lifecycle: draft -> review -> publish
flows.trigger: Author writes an article; moderator reviews/publishes

steps.action: createArticleDraft / submitArticleForReview -> status='in_review' (validates cover, excerpt, body)
Moderator (content scope) approveArticle -> requireCapability gate -> status='published', publishedAt, approvedBy
publishArticleToSanity mirrors publish (async; failure does not roll back Neon)

flows.endState: Published article live at /articles/[slug] (Sanity GROQ filters publishedAt < now()).
rules: APPROVE_ARTICLE gates the review queue; PUBLISH_ARTICLE gates the status->published flip (CLAUDE.md §10.6)
Sanity Studio publishes must route through the Next.js server action gate, not Sanity directly

flows.name: Editable site content (Sanity siteSettings)
flows.trigger: Editor updates homepage/about content in Studio

steps.action: Edit siteSettings singleton (landingHero, featuredVideo, impactTestimonials, environmentalStats, FAQ, history, OG images, sign-in image authImage)
fetchSiteSettings() GROQ pulls into marketing pages
HeroSection/FeaturedVideoSection consume copy; fall back to DEFAULT_COPY if empty

flows.endState: Homepage/about reflect CMS content; business logic & nav remain hardcoded.
rules: Hero copy/image, testimonials, env stats, FAQ, timeline editable. authImage now feeds the sign-in page's right-side panel (login renders it via fetchSiteSettings). Many landing 'main sections' are still hardcoded components — candidate for new schema fields.

flows.name: Merchandise catalog sync (Sanity -> Neon)

steps.action: upsertMerchandiseStock() requireCapability('UPSERT_MERCHANDISE_STOCK'); GROQ pulls active products
Upsert into merchandise by sanityProductId (preserves stockCount; inventory is Neon-only)
setMerchandiseStockCount() adjusts stock directly

flows.endState: Active products appear at /shop with current stock.
rules: Product content in Sanity; stock count authoritative in Neon

flows.name: Store checkout & race-safe inventory

steps.action: CartProvider holds cart in localStorage; add-to-cart validates stockCount>0
Paystack inline widget (amount in kobo, metadata.type='order', items map)
Webhook charge.success -> INSERT orders + per-item decrementStock()
Atomic: UPDATE merchandise SET stock_count = stock_count - 1 WHERE id=$1 AND stock_count > 0 RETURNING * (empty -> OUT_OF_STOCK)

flows.endState: Order recorded as paid; stock decremented safely; confirmation + email.
rules: Never read-then-write inventory; single atomic UPDATE ... RETURNING (CLAUDE.md §8)

flows.name: Donation

steps.action: openDonate() opens singleton modal (cause RUGBY|ECO|EDU, amount, email)
Paystack newTransaction (KES, metadata.type='donation', cause custom field)
Webhook charge.success -> INSERT donations (+ userBadges 'Supporter' if authed) + thank-you email

flows.endState: Donation recorded with fund allocation; receipt emailed; Supporter badge for logged-in users.
rules: Donate is a global header CTA across guest + authed (CLAUDE.md §6)

flows.name: Corporate partner reporting (Looker Studio)
flows.trigger: Corporate partner views their ESG dashboard

steps.action: getCsrStats(partnerId) computes mentees sponsored, active mentorships, donations, projects
LookerEmbed renders iframe from corporate_partners.lookerReportId; share link from lookerShareUrl

flows.endState: Sponsor sees CSR stat cards + embedded Looker dashboard + forwardable share link.
rules: No in-app custom reporting UI; Looker Studio is canonical (CLAUDE.md §10.5, §11)
Per-partner isolation via hardcoded data-source filter OR per-partner pgView

flows.name: Role-based dashboard routing

steps.action: Layout: require auth (else /login); require mentee intake (else /onboarding/intake)
Redirect to role hub: admin|moderator|mentor|mentee|partner|ngo
RoleSidebar renders role-specific links; route capabilities enforced for admin/moderator routes

flows.endState: User lands on their role hub with scoped navigation.
rules: Header state is auth-driven, never route-driven (CLAUDE.md §6)
